answer: In our architecture, each agent identity is bound to a cryptographically attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE). Valid state commitments are inscribed as if by an unforgeable quill, rooted in hardware attestation. Because cloning identities requires physical silicon purchase rather than virtual machine duplication, Sybil adversaries fail. Like a falcon scanning a vast dune, the network verifies discrete hardware roots of trust to ensure true physical scarcity.
